title: Money required per day for the main destinations from Tunisia (Visa Code Handbook Annex 18, version 24 Oct 2024)

facts.statement: France: EUR 120 per day without a hotel booking; EUR 65 per day for nights covered by a hotel booking; EUR 32.50 per day when staying with a host (attestation d'accueil).
facts.quote: where no hotel reservation is presented as proof of accommodation, the minimum amount of money per day required to stay in France is € 120

facts.statement: Italy (tourism, one traveller): EUR 269.60 in total for 1–5 days; EUR 44.93 per day for 6–10 days; EUR 51.64 + 36.67/day for 11–20 days; EUR 206.58 + 27.89/day beyond 20 days.
facts.quote: the minimum means of support needed per person for the issue of a visa and for entry to Italian territory for the purpose of tourism are defined in accordance with Table A

facts.statement: Germany: no fixed amount; case by case. Without other evidence, about EUR 45 per day.
facts.quote: Mandatory reference amounts per day have not been set. ... he should have € 45 per day at his disposal.

facts.statement: Spain: 10% of the Spanish gross minimum wage per day (EUR 113.40 at the time of the annex), and at least 90% of it per person in total (EUR 1,020.60).
facts.quote: 10% of the gross national minimum wage (EUR 113.40) ... multiplied by the number of days they intend to stay in Spain
facts.notes: The amount follows the minimum wage, which rises yearly — check the current value.

facts.statement: Belgium: about EUR 95 per day when staying at a hotel; about EUR 45 per day when staying with a private host without a guarantee letter.
facts.quote: he must have access to approximately EUR 95 for each day of the planned stay

facts.statement: Switzerland: about CHF 100 per day; students with a valid student card about CHF 30 per day.
facts.quote: must prove that they possess approx. CHF 100.-- per day. Students who can prove their identity by means of a valid student card must possess approx. CHF 30.-- per day.

facts.statement: Netherlands: EUR 55 per person per day (applied flexibly).
facts.quote: currently EUR 55 per person per day

facts.statement: Austria: no reference amount; decided case by case.
facts.quote: there are no reference amounts for the above. Decisions are made on a case-by-case basis

facts.statement: Portugal: EUR 75 per entry plus EUR 40 per day.
facts.quote: EUR 75 – for each entry - EUR 40 – for each day spent on the territory

facts.statement: Greece: EUR 50 per person per day, at least EUR 300 for stays up to 5 days (half for minors).
facts.quote: fixed at EUR 50 per person per day, and a minimum total amount of EUR 300 for a stay of up to 5 days
